title: Have you tested the weekend?
hook: The effect depends on the day. Which days should your average represent?

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: a test run only on weekdays can mislead about weekend users.

misconception: Treating monday vs weekend as valid without checking the stated model, denominators or causal assumptions.
objective: a test run only on weekdays can mislead about weekend users.
keyState: Both finite cases completed; their computed summaries retained.

claims.text: A change adds 10 percentage points on weekdays and loses 10 on weekends. Giving each of seven days equal weight, what is the weekly average?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-monday-vs-weekend/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Weekday lift+10pp, weekend lift-10pp. Fiveweekday/twoweekend uniform-day average(5*10-2*10)/7=4.2857pp; weekdays-only10pp; weekend-heavy traffic weights.3/.7 gives-4pp.
